scenario_description: 3p, empty stacks, player 0 on turn. Player 0 slot 1 (deck 4) is R1, inferred and directly playable. The downstream is deliberately 'dry and dangerous': Bob and Cathy hold only fully-clued high cards (all five 5s and the four-rank) with no playable card anywhere on the board, and only 2 clue tokens remain, so within the search horizon the team is forced toward catastrophic discards. A horizon-stalling engine would give a wasteful re-clue to push that foreseen discard past the horizon; the correct action is simply to cash the known R1 (deck 4).
